reason: Phagocytes are shown clearing debris near the still-open wound, making them a plausible first repair step.
expectation: The phagocytes will clear debris from the wound.

effect: Debris has been cleared, and the wound now needs supply, surface and support.
reaction: The three labelled repair slots make the next tasks clear.
reason: The repair signals point to the nearby vessel, suggesting a route to supply the wound.
expectation: The signals will prompt the capillary to contribute to the wound's blood supply.

effect: The repair signals produced a capillary sprout connected to the existing circulation, suggesting it can supply the wound.
reaction: The connected sprout makes the source of the new blood supply clear.
reason: The new capillary branch appears to fit the wound's empty Supply slot.
expectation: The capillary sprout will supply the healing wound.

effect: The capillary sprout is installed and forms a connected blood-flow route to the developing tissue.
reaction: The completed loop makes the supply connection clear.
reason: The fibroblast picture shows a collagen gene, and the RNA building blocks enter its nucleus, suggesting the first step in making wound support.
expectation: The fibroblasts will make an RNA message for collagen production.

effect: The fibroblasts now have a collagen RNA message ready for protein production.
reaction: The picture clearly distinguishes the DNA from its RNA copy.
reason: Matrix nutrients include amino acids, which the fibroblasts need to make collagen.
expectation: The fibroblasts will use the RNA instructions and nutrients to produce collagen for wound support.

effect: The fibroblasts have produced extracellular collagen fibres, providing material for the wound's support slot.
reaction: The sequence connects the RNA message to exported collagen clearly.
reason: The new connective tissue appears to fit the healing wound's support slot.
expectation: The connective tissue will support the damaged dermis.

effect: The new connective tissue now supports the wound, though it remains weaker than uninjured skin.
reaction: The distinction between young repair tissue and uninjured skin is useful.
reason: The epidermal edge cells and their nutrients suggest a way to rebuild the wound surface.
expectation: The nourished edge cells will produce a new surface layer for the wound.

effect: The edge cells formed a new epidermal sheet across the gap, ready for the wound's surface slot.
reaction: The sheet extending from the wound edge makes closure easy to follow.
reason: The new surface fits the remaining surface slot in the healing skin.
expectation: The new epidermal sheet will close the wound surface.

effect: The wound now has a closed surface, connective support and a blood supply; the temporary clot still needs clearing.
reaction: It is useful that closure is distinguished from full tissue strength.
reason: The clot-clearing enzymes break down fibrin, matching the remaining goal.
expectation: The enzymes will break down the temporary fibrin clot.

effect: The temporary fibrin has largely cleared, leaving closed skin and a scar that is still maturing; both goals are complete.
reaction: The distinction between clot removal and continuing scar maturation is useful.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making connective tissue was most worthwhile: the planned sequence links a collagen gene’s RNA copy to protein production and exported fibres that support the wound.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting each finished component into the healing skin was clear but somewhat repetitive after constructing it.

surprise.text: The new capillary branch joined another vessel to form a flow route, rather than merely ending at the wound.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though combining edge cells with generic nutrients compressed the process of forming a surface into one step without explaining how the cells move or multiply.

continue.text: I would choose to continue if another chapter connected mechanisms this clearly to a larger outcome; the wound sequence was useful, although its repeated fitting steps were less engaging.
